responsibility: Provides the crate’s complete baked ICU data provider surface by organizing the baked datasets for locale fallback and list formatting, defining the generated per-key provider macros for those datasets, and assembling them into `BakedDataProvider` with `AnyProvider` support. Within this module, the `fallback` subtree groups the likely-subtags, parent-locale, and collation supplement payloads used by locale fallback; the `list` subtree groups the locale-indexed conjunction-list formatting payloads; `macros.rs` and its generated `*.data.rs` files define and re-export the macros that attach `DataProvider` implementations for each data key; `data/mod.rs` wires all submodules together and declares `BakedDataProvider`; and `any.rs` extends that provider with runtime-dispatched `AnyProvider` access across all baked keys exposed here.
